name: Westfield Fashion Square
description: Westfield Fashion Square is a premier shopping destination in the heart of Sherman Oaks, featuring an impressive collection of top-tier retailers including Apple, Bloomingdale's, Macy's, Sephora, and Tesla Motors alongside contemporary fashion brands like H&M, Hollister, and Coach. The center offers a modern shopping experience with diverse dining options from Kura Revolving Sushi Bar to Panini Kabob Grill, complemented by fitness and entertainment venues. With convenient amenities including free Wi-Fi, EV charging stations, and engaging community events throughout the year, Fashion Square serves as the San Fernando Valley's go-to retail hub.
demographics: Westfield Fashion Square attracts an affluent, fashion-conscious demographic from the San Fernando Valley, with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle-class households earning $75,000-$150,000+ annually. The trade area draws families, young professionals, and upscale shoppers aged 25-54 who prioritize premium brands and dining experiences. Visitors typically exhibit strong purchasing power and gravitate toward contemporary fashion retailers, beauty destinations like Sephora, and experiential dining options. The center serves as the primary shopping destination for Sherman Oaks, Encino, and surrounding affluent Valley communities.
summary: Westfield Fashion Square is Sherman Oaks' premier shopping destination, offering upscale retail anchored by Bloomingdale's and Macy's with contemporary dining and modern amenities in the heart of the San Fernando Valley.
